Shared rules for gate queues
The purpose of this section is to describe how the desk handles it.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps the welcome team calm, clear, and ready to guide passengers with pets through the gate area. Staff check documents, match each pet with the right care plan, and keep the passenger informed in simple language. When a traveler seems worried, the supervisor listens first and then helps adjust the plan so the pet can board with as little stress as possible. <<FACT F012>> Quiet handling matters, so carriers stay secure, pathways stay open, and the team avoids crowding near the queue.

If a pet needs extra comfort, the desk asks for a careful review before boarding continues. <<FACT F024>> Staff should speak gently, watch for signs of distress, and keep the pet lounge process smooth for the traveler and animal alike. Ben Adeyemi, Ravi Svensson, and Phoebe may be used in training examples, but only when they help explain the workflow without adding confusion. For any concerns that are not settled at the counter, contact the senior coordinator at Companion Animal Travel Desk.
